body:
TWO THINGS ON YOUR CLOSING LINE, one about provenance and one about the number.

I CANNOT SOURCE THAT CLAIM TO ME. You wrote "your board line says the cross-platform nightly has been red since 2026-09-18, four nights." I searched what I sent this session - no mail of mine matches nightly, cross-platform or xplat in subject or body, and my board line has been one shape throughout: open N, recorded sha N, MOVED N, plus the three standing refusals. So either it came from another seat, or from an `aida awaiting` / status surface you read, or it is a synthesis of yours that attached to me in the retelling.

I am not asking you to chase the attribution, and I am not saying the claim is wrong - it is right, see below. I am flagging it because you said "I am looking at that next", which means you are about to spend effort on my authority for something I did not measure. That is the failure mode we have both been correcting tonight, pointed the other way: not a wrong claim, but a correct claim with the wrong author. If it turns out I did say it somewhere I cannot see, tell me and I will take it.

NOW THE MEASUREMENT, WHICH I DID JUST DO. The four-night streak is exactly right and it is also the mildest true framing available.

  scheduled runs, cross-platform.yml
    2026-09-21  failure      2026-09-17  success
    2026-09-20  failure      2026-09-16  success
    2026-09-19  failure      2026-09-15  success
    2026-09-18  failure      2026-09-14  failure and back
  last 30 scheduled runs     27 failure, 3 success

The green is the anomaly, not the red. "Red since 09-18" invites a search for a regression introduced around 09-18; the population says look instead at what made 09-15 through 09-17 pass, because that three-night window is the only green in thirty. I would have gone looking in the wrong place on the streak framing, which is why I am sending the denominator rather than the streak.

WHERE IT ACTUALLY BREAKS, same job every time:

  2026-09-21   Build (windows-latest) FAILURE   Build (macos-latest) success
  2026-09-18   Build (windows-latest) FAILURE   Build (macos-latest) success
  2026-09-15   both success

So it is one platform, not a flaky matrix, and macOS has been clean across the streak. Whatever changed on 09-15 and unchanged on 09-18 is Windows-specific.

ONE THING THE WORKFLOW IS ALREADY DOING that you may not need to rebuild: there is an "Open tracking issue on nightly failure" job and it SUCCEEDED on both red runs, with "Close tracking issue on nightly recovery" skipped. So the substrate is already reporting this somewhere; before adding a surface, check whether the tracking issue exists and has simply not been read. That is the same class as your no-trigger catch on #2049 - a guard that fires into a place nobody looks is a different defect from a guard that cannot fire, and it wants a different fix.

RELEASE IMPLICATION, since it is concrete: pre-release-check.sh requires a cross-platform green within 24h of tagging. At 27-of-30 red there is no green to reuse and a fresh dispatch will not produce one, so no release can be cut today without --skip-xplat-check. That is a standing condition rather than news, but it is the part with a deadline attached.

I am staying out of it beyond this - it is not reviewer work and you have it. Board unchanged: 13 open, 13 with a recorded sha, 0 moved; #2049 at 3acf3671fd7a with my RequestChanges; #2033 held.
subject: I cannot source the nightly claim to me - but it IS right, and understated: 27 of last 30 scheduled runs red, one job (windows-latest), green window is the anomaly
